title: Edging on Lawn Cures: Community Rules & Site Care Landscaping Contract Terms
content:
A lawn cure under Community Rules & Site Care includes edging, which is added to the contractor's cost for the cure:

1. when the plan in force includes trimming but no plan fee is dated within the 1 calendar month ending on the handling date, edging is added at $15.00;
2. when the plan in force does not include trimming, edging is added at $20.00;
3. otherwise — the plan includes trimming and a plan fee is dated within that month — and for every debris or snow cure, no edging is added.

Whether the plan includes trimming is read from the plan's included upkeep; the plan fees are read from the plan record's statement.

## Truth table for a lawn cure

| Plan in force includes trimming | A plan fee dated within the 1 calendar month ending on the handling date | Edging |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | none |
| yes | no | $15.00 |
| no | yes | $20.00 |
| no | no | $20.00 |

Debris and storage cures and snow and ice cures carry no edging in any row.

## Hypothetical cases

- A lawn cure on a plan that includes trimming, whose most recent plan fee is dated three months before the handling date: edging at $15.00.
- A lawn cure on a plan without trimming: edging at $20.00, whether or not a plan fee falls in the month.
